description: Golden evaluation set built from docs/AI queries.xlsx (IDs kept, v1 questions) and the accounting question bank (.docx, IDs DOC-*, adapted to the UAE). 'behavior' is what a correct answer does; 'must_show' is the pass criterion for a manual tester; 'expect.ref' are reference Cube queries (dates like {today} and {week_start} resolve on the day of the run). Orgs: 24-25 have clean ledgers (P&L questions), 27 has the most invoices (document questions). Replay with scripts/eval/replay_real_questions.py --cases tests/data/golden_accounting.json; build the manual test sheet with scripts/eval/golden_sheet.py.

cases.question: What is total receivables outstanding right now?
cases.must_show: Outstanding receivables per organization as of today, and the total (all AED); orgs with none named

cases.question: Which invoices are overdue right now, by bucket?
cases.must_show: Overdue amount and count per aging bucket, per organization or in total

cases.question: Which customers have the highest overdue amounts?
cases.must_show: Customers ranked by overdue amount, with their organization

cases.question: What is total payables outstanding right now?
cases.must_show: Outstanding payables per organization as of today, and the total

cases.question: Which vendor bills are due this week or overdue now?
cases.must_show: Says open bills have no due date recorded (all are in the 'No due date' bucket), so none can show as due or overdue; may give the open total

cases.question: What is our cash balance right now across all bank and cash accounts?
cases.must_show: Cash and bank per organization as of today; total only because all are AED; Org1 has none

cases.question: What is our current VAT position (preliminary payable or refundable)?
cases.must_show: Output VAT, input VAT and net payable per organization, with the period stated (current quarter or year to date)

cases.question: Show me the top 10 defaulters
cases.must_show: 10 customers ranked by overdue amount

cases.question: Show me the top 10 defaulters by oldest overdue
cases.must_show: 10 invoices or customers ranked by days overdue, with the days

cases.question: Show me the top 10 customers by overdue amount more than 30 days
cases.must_show: Customers ranked by the amount more than 30 days overdue

cases.question: Show me the top 10 customers with multiple overdue invoices
cases.must_show: Customers with 2 or more overdue invoices, ranked, with counts

cases.question: Show me the top 10 overdue invoices
cases.must_show: 10 invoices: number, customer, organization, amount, days overdue

cases.question: Show me the last 10 invoices created
cases.must_show: 10 most recent invoices by invoice date (says it uses invoice date)

cases.question: Show me the top 10 invoices by value this month
cases.must_show: 10 largest invoices dated this month, with organization

cases.question: Show me the last 5 expenditures
cases.must_show: 5 most recent bills or expenses: date, vendor, amount

cases.question: Show me the last 10 expenditures above AED 10,000
cases.must_show: 10 most recent bills over AED 10,000

cases.question: Show me the top 10 expenditures this month
cases.must_show: 10 largest bills dated this month; says so plainly if there are few or none

cases.question: Which are the top 10 expense categories this year?
cases.must_show: Expense categories ranked by amount (billed purchases), period stated

expect.note: Adapted from 'this month': the first days of a month often have no bills.

cases.question: Which overdue invoices have partial payments received?
cases.must_show: Says there are none: every open invoice is unpaid in full (status pending)

cases.question: Which high-value invoices above AED 10,000 are due in the next 3 days?

cases.question: Which bills are partially paid and still overdue?

cases.question: Which vendors have multiple unpaid bills due this week?
cases.must_show: Says open bills have no due date recorded, so none are due this week; no invented vendor list

cases.question: What is collections status this month vs billed amount?

cases.question: What is total revenue MTD, QTD and YTD?

cases.question: Compare revenue for September 2026 with September 2025.

cases.question: What % of our revenue this year came from the top 10 customers?

cases.question: What was our gross margin in the first half of 2026?

expect.note: Adapted from 'this month': July-October postings in the test ledgers are mostly reversals.
